summary: Two single-constant edits to the baseline account for the whole gain: tokens/step 2**19 -> 2**18 (val_bpb 0.997333 -> 0.988049) and width 512 -> 640 at depth 8 (-> 0.984898). The baseline batch was far above the useful batch size for this model in 5 minutes, and widening is cheaper than it looks because MFU rises from 35% to 42%. What did not work: going further in either direction -- batch 2**17 (0.994781), width 768 (0.992199), depth 10 at width 640 (0.990065) -- and putting value embeddings on all 8 layers instead of the alternating 4 (0.985588, a wash). Next I would re-scan batch size at the 640d shape (the optimum may have moved) and re-tune Muon/embedding LRs, which were tuned for 512d at twice the batch and ~half the step count.
